notebooksurvivors.title: Notebook Survivors - Privacy Policy
notebooksurvivors.intro1: This Privacy Policy applies to the mobile game <1>Notebook Survivors</1> (Package Name: <2>com.hck.notebooksurvivors</2>, the "Application"), developed and published by <1>HCK Applications</1> ("we", "us", or the "Developer").
notebooksurvivors.intro2: Your privacy is extremely important to us. This document has been prepared in full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (<1>GDPR</1>), California Consumer Privacy Act (<1>CCPA/CPRA</1>), Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (<1>COPPA</1>), the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (<1>KVKK</1>), as well as <1>Google Play Developer Program Policies</1> and <1>Apple App Store Review Guidelines</1>.
notebooksurvivors.intro3: By downloading, installing, or playing Notebook Survivors, you agree to the data collection and processing practices described in this Privacy Policy.
notebooksurvivors.section1Text: The data controller responsible for the processing of your data is:
notebooksurvivors.section1Footer: For any privacy-related inquiries, access requests, or data deletion requests, please contact us at the email address above.
notebooksurvivors.section2Text1: Notebook Survivors does <1>NOT</1> require user account registration (no name, email address, password, or profile creation). The game is designed to be fully playable immediately on your device.
notebooksurvivors.section2Text2: However, to ensure smooth technical performance, prevent crashes, process digital purchases, deliver in-game rewards via ads, and support optional cloud saves, limited technical data is processed through trusted third-party SDKs:
notebooksurvivors.section2ATitle: A. Automatically Collected Technical & Analytical Data
notebooksurvivors.section2AText: When you open and play the game, trusted third-party SDKs may automatically process:
notebooksurvivors.section2AItem1: Device and Hardware Data: Device brand/model, operating system version, system language, screen resolution, and rendering performance.
notebooksurvivors.section2AItem2: Network & Coarse Location: IP address (used solely for approximate country/city level geolocation, anti-fraud verification, and regional ad serving; precise GPS location is never requested or collected).
notebooksurvivors.section2AItem3: Advertising & Diagnostic Identifiers: Google Advertising ID (AAID/GAID), Apple Advertising Identifier (IDFA/IDFV), and RevenueCat Anonymous App User ID.
notebooksurvivors.section2AItem4: Gameplay Activity: Chapter/level completions, earned in-game gold, unlocked weapons, and rewarded ad view statistics.
notebooksurvivors.section2BTitle: B. In-App Purchases and Financial Information
notebooksurvivors.section2BText: Players can purchase optional digital items (such as Star Packs) to support development and accelerate passive upgrades:
notebooksurvivors.section2BItem1: Payment & Billing Data: All financial transactions and payment processing are handled exclusively by the Google Play Store (Google LLC) or Apple App Store (Apple Inc.). We do not collect, view, or store credit card numbers, bank account numbers, or billing addresses.
notebooksurvivors.section2BItem2: Receipt Validation: To verify purchases and grant digital goods to your game account, only transaction tokens/receipts, purchase timestamps, currency, and product IDs are validated via RevenueCat.
notebooksurvivors.section2CText: When an unexpected error or game crash occurs, anonymous diagnostic reports are collected:
notebooksurvivors.section2CItem1: The line of code where the error occurred, stack traces, memory state, and OS version.
notebooksurvivors.section2CItem2: These reports are processed through GlitchTip / Sentry to help us quickly patch bugs and improve stability in subsequent game updates.
notebooksurvivors.section2DItem1: Support Inquiries: If you email us at hckapplications@gmail.com, your email address and message contents will be used solely to respond to and resolve your inquiry.
notebooksurvivors.section2DItem2: Game Services Login: If you choose to log in with Google Play Games or Apple Game Center, your gamer tag, achievements, and cloud save data are synchronized with those official platform services.
notebooksurvivors.section3Text: We use industry-standard, reputable third-party Software Development Kits (SDKs) to deliver essential game features:
notebooksurvivors.section3_1Purpose: Purpose: To serve non-intrusive in-game advertisements (specifically opt-in rewarded video ads where players voluntarily choose to watch an ad for extra gold or revives).
notebooksurvivors.section3_1Data: Data Processed: Advertising identifiers (AAID/IDFA), coarse location derived from IP address, ad views, and ad interaction metrics.
notebooksurvivors.section3_2Purpose: Purpose: To securely manage in-app purchase validation, store receipts, and unlock purchased digital content.
notebooksurvivors.section3_2Data: Data Processed: Anonymous App User ID, purchase receipts, transaction dates, and product identifiers.
notebooksurvivors.section3_3Title: 3. GlitchTip / Sentry SDK (GlitchTip & Functional Software, Inc.)
notebooksurvivors.section3_3Purpose: Purpose: Real-time monitoring of unexpected runtime exceptions, fatal crashes, and save errors.
notebooksurvivors.section3_3Data: Data Processed: Crash diagnostic data, stack traces, device model, and operating system.
notebooksurvivors.section3_3Note: Privacy Note: Sensitive personal details are filtered out; session tracking and user tracking are disabled.
notebooksurvivors.section3_4Title: 4. Google Play Games Services (Google LLC) & Apple Game Center (Apple Inc.)
notebooksurvivors.section3_4Purpose: Purpose: Optional cloud saves and achievements across your devices.
notebooksurvivors.section3_4Data: Data Processed: Gamer profile ID, achievement status, and save game data.
notebooksurvivors.section4Text: In strict adherence to the data minimization principle, Notebook Survivors requests only the bare minimum permissions necessary to function:
notebooksurvivors.section4Item1: Internet Access (android.permission.INTERNET): Required to load opt-in rewarded ads, validate digital purchases, and submit anonymous crash logs.
notebooksurvivors.section4Item2: Billing Permission (com.android.vending.BILLING): Used by the Google Play Billing Library to process in-app purchases.
notebooksurvivors.section4Item3: Network State (android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE): Detects active internet connectivity to ensure seamless transitions between offline and online play.
notebooksurvivors.section4Item4: Permissions We NEVER Request: We do NOT request access to your Camera, Microphone, Contacts, Calendar, SMS, or Precise GPS Location.
notebooksurvivors.section4Item5: Local Storage (SQLite & SharedPreferences): Game progress, unlocked weapons, sound settings, and passive skill levels are saved locally on your device storage, enabling 100% offline gameplay.
notebooksurvivors.section5Text1: Notebook Survivors is a general audience doodle roguelite action game. We do not knowingly or intentionally collect personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 where local law specifies).
notebooksurvivors.section5Text2: If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that your child has provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us immediately at hckapplications@gmail.com. Upon verification, we will promptly delete any associated identifiers from our systems and third-party partners.
notebooksurvivors.section6Item1: Security: All network communications are encrypted in transit using industry-standard HTTPS / TLS 1.3 encryption protocols.
notebooksurvivors.section6Item2: Retention: Local game data remains on your device until you uninstall the app or clear app data. Third-party analytical and crash logs are retained according to the providers' standard data retention periods (typically 30 days to 14 months) and are permanently purged or anonymized thereafter.
notebooksurvivors.section6Item3: No Sale of Data: HCK Applications does not sell, rent, trade, or monetize personal user data to any third party.
notebooksurvivors.section7Title: 7. User Rights and Choices (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, KVKK)
notebooksurvivors.section7Intro: Depending on your country or state of residence, you have the right to:
notebooksurvivors.section7Item1: Access: Inquire about the personal information we process about you.
notebooksurvivors.section7Item2: Correction & Deletion: Request the correction of inaccuracies or deletion of your data (Right to be Forgotten).
notebooksurvivors.section7Item3_Android: Android: Settings → Google → Ads → Reset advertising ID / Delete advertising ID.
notebooksurvivors.section7Item3_iOS: iOS: Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking → Disable "Allow Apps to Request to Track".
notebooksurvivors.section7Item4: Objection: Object to data processing or withdraw previously granted consent at any time.
notebooksurvivors.section7Footer: To exercise these rights, please email us at hckapplications@gmail.com. We will respond to and fulfill verifiable requests within 30 days free of charge.
notebooksurvivors.section8Text1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements or application updates.
notebooksurvivors.section8Text2: The updated date will always be visible under "Last Updated" at the top of this document. Material changes will be accompanied by in-game notices or app store release notes.
notebooksurvivors.section9Text: If you have any questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out to:
